**About Flex Learning**

Flex Learning, LLC is a growing behavioral health organization providing individualized Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and behavioral support services to children, adolescents, and adults throughout the Los Angeles area.

We are committed to delivering compassionate, high-quality services while fostering a collaborative and supportive environment for our employees.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented entry level **Operations Coordinator** to support our administrative operations, human resources functions, employee engagement, and organizational development.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys working with people, managing multiple responsibilities, improving processes, and contributing to a growing healthcare organization.

This position works closely with the Owner/Clinical Director and Administrative Assistant and serves as an important resource for employees, applicants, and the community.

* Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, applicant communication, and interview scheduling.
* Facilitate new-hire onboarding, orientation, and administrative training.
* Maintain accurate employee records, compliance documentation, and training trackers.
* Conduct routine employee check-ins and assist with employee engagement initiatives.
* Support performance review coordination and staff development activities.
* Assist with administrative aspects of scheduling, attendance, and workforce management.

**Operations & Quality Assurance**

* Monitor administrative workflows, deadlines, and assigned operational tasks.

* Track employee credentials, certifications, and required training.

* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of organizational policies and procedures.

* Coordinate internal meetings, training sessions, interviews, and organizational events.
* Maintain administrative calendars, documents, and operational trackers.
* Assist with office organization, inventory, equipment, and storage management.
* Support special projects and other administrative responsibilities as assigned.

**Recruitment & Community Outreach**

* Participate in job fairs, resource fairs, and recruitment events.
* Assist with employee engagement and internal communication initiatives.
* Represent Flex Learning professionally when interacting with applicants, employees, and community partners.

**Required:**

* Must be at least 18 years of age.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources or a related field
* Strong organizational, time-management, and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to work independently and proactively resolve routine operational challenges.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain confidential information.
* Ability to work the established schedule and attend required in-person activities, with reasonable accommodations as applicable.
* Bilingual Spanish speaking

**Preferred:**

* Experience in human resources, administrative coordination, office management, or recruitment.
* Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, or Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA).
* Familiarity with onboarding, employee compliance, and HR management systems.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, subject to eligibility and plan terms.
* Employer-paid life insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid vacation and sick leave.

We are building a welcoming, patient-centered environment where personalized care, meaningful relationships, and attention to detail are priorities.

You will work closely with Dr. Stone to coordinate patient care, manage daily office operations, and help establish efficient workflows as the practice grows.

* Identify opportunities to improve office efficiency and the patient experience.
* Take ownership of day-to-day operations in collaboration with the physician.

* Experience with electronic health records and familiarity with HIPAA requirements.

We are especially interested in candidates who enjoy taking initiative, managing multiple responsibilities, and growing with a practice over time.

**About the Role**
------------------

LiveX AI is looking for a proactive, technical Customer Success Manager to own the post-sales experience for our mid-market customers. You will be the day-to-day owner of a book of existing accounts, so that our Sales and Solution Engineering teams can focus on new and strategic accounts. Sales and Solution Engineering continue to own new customer acquisition and the relationship with strategic accounts, while you support strategic accounts with day-to-day work such as version updates, configuration, and account analysis. Depending on experience, you may also manage some of our larger accounts.

This is a technical, customer-facing role. You will own anything in a customer's account that does not require a code change: configuring and updating their AI agents, resolving support issues, and keeping their deployment on the latest version of our product. For your existing accounts, you will also be the first point of contact in customer meetings, collecting information and addressing concerns before bringing in Solution Engineering when needed.

Beyond keeping accounts stable and healthy, you will review each account every week to find ways to improve results and to spot upsell opportunities, and you will keep customers up to date on new LiveX AI offerings. When an opportunity comes up, you will help close it.

Years of experience matter less to us than technical ability and initiative. This role suits someone who is technically curious, takes ownership without being asked, and enjoys working directly with customers in a fast-paced startup.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Post-Sales Technical Support**

* Get involved with new accounts after launch, and take full ownership from Sales and Solution Engineering once the deployment is stable (typically 30+ days after onboarding) and the customer is happy.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned mid-market accounts after deployment.
* Provide high-quality technical support and own the resolution of any issue that does not require a code change, such as agent configuration, knowledge base updates, conversation flows, and troubleshooting.
* Escalate issues that require engineering work to Solution Engineering with clear context and reproduction steps, and follow them through to resolution.

**Customer Meetings**

* Lead regular meetings with your existing accounts as the first-line contact, gathering requirements, feedback, and technical details.
* Address customer questions and concerns directly where you can, and hand off to Solution Engineering with a clear summary when deeper technical work is needed.

**Product Updates & Service Quality**

* Keep every customer's AI agent up to date with the latest product version so customers always receive a high-quality service.
* Plan and communicate updates with customers, test changes before release, and confirm everything works as expected afterward.

**Account Analysis & Growth**

* Review each account weekly, using conversation data and usage metrics, to identify areas for improvement and upsell opportunities.
* Share findings and recommendations with customers and with the internal team.
* Keep customers informed about the latest LiveX AI offerings and features, and explore where they could add value for each account.
* Bring upsell and expansion opportunities to the Account Executive, who decides how each one is handled, and close deals yourself when the AE hands them to you.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* 1+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Technical Support, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, or Account Management. Recent graduates with strong technical skills and relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply.
* Strong technical aptitude: comfortable configuring software products, troubleshooting issues, and learning new technology quickly.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the confidence to lead parts of customer meetings.
* Analytical skills to review account data, spot trends, and turn them into concrete recommendations.
* A proactive work style: you take ownership, follow up without being reminded, and look for problems before customers report them.

**Preferred**

* Experience selling, upselling, or closing expansion deals.
* Experience with AI, conversational AI, or B2B SaaS products.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, or basic scripting.
* Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Experience working in an early-stage startup.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Mid-market customers receive fast, high-quality support, and most issues are resolved without involving Solution Engineering.
* Every customer's AI agent runs on the latest product version.
* Sales and Solution Engineering spend their time on new and strategic accounts rather than ongoing support for existing ones.
* Each account has a weekly review with clear improvement actions and documented upsell opportunities.
* Customer satisfaction and retention stay high, and existing accounts grow through upsells.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Base Salary:** $100,000 - $130,000 annually
* **Variable Compensation:** May be eligible for performance-based incentives, such as a bonus or commission, in accordance with the company's applicable plans.
* **Equity:** Stock options may be offered as part of the total compensation package.
* **Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and other company-sponsored benefits.

Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, role responsibilities, and internal equity.
